description: Captions a local video or audio file with the Cuecaps studio's renderer in headless Chrome or Edge and writes <name>.captions.<ext> next to it, never replacing a file: an MP4 with the captions burned in, a transparent MOV or WebM overlay, or SRT or VTT subtitles. With fast, Fast edit cuts dead space, filler words and retakes, punches in on the jump cuts and levels the volume before it renders. Returns the file, the input's duration in seconds, the engine, the cloud minutes used and a studio link to fine-tune words, cuts and style. Needs a Creator or Pro key; 1440p and 4K need Pro. Transcription works as in transcribe, and the video never leaves this machine. Use transcribe when only the words are needed, and studio_link when the user wants to edit by hand or has no key.

anim.description: How each caption comes in: pop, punch (slams down from large), bounce, rise, slide, fade, focus (from a blur), typewriter (letter by letter) or none.

aspect.description: Frame shape: 9:16 for TikTok, Shorts and Reels, 1:1 or 4:5 for feed posts, 16:9 for YouTube.

case.description: Letter case: upper for capitals, lower, or as-spoken.

color.description: Text color: a hex value such as #FFFFFF, or white, black, yellow, gold, orange, red, pink, purple, blue, cyan, green, lime.

emphasis.description: Color of the key words the studio picks for emphasis, as a hex value or a color name.

engine.description: cloud: ElevenLabs Scribe on the plan's cloud minutes, strongest on music, accents and 90+ languages; the default when the minutes left cover the file. device: on-device Fluid Speech Pro (Whisper base for the languages it lacks), no minutes; the first run downloads the model (764 MB).

fast.description: Fast edit tools to turn on once the words are found: deadspace cuts the pauses, fillers cuts um, uh and stutters, retakes keeps the last take of a restarted sentence, zoom punches in on the jump cuts, norm levels the volume to -14 LUFS. all turns on every one. Captions, subtitles and overlays follow the cut.

font.description: Caption font, in place of the style's own.

highlight.description: Color of the word being spoken, as a hex value or a color name. A style that doesn't color the spoken word starts to.

keyterms.description: Names and words for cloud transcription to spell your way.

lang.description: The spoken language. Give it for any video that isn't in English; auto lets cloud transcription detect it.

mark.description: How the spoken word stands out: color it, a box behind it, grow it, dim the words not yet spoken, reveal words as they are spoken, or none.

out_path.description: Absolute path to write to instead of <name>.captions.<ext> next to the input, ending in .mp4, .mov, .webm, .srt or .vtt; its extension sets output. An existing file is never replaced: -2, -3 and so on go before the extension.

output.description: mp4 with the captions burned in, mov or webm as a transparent captions-only overlay, or srt or vtt subtitles. Defaults to out_path's extension when out_path is given, else mp4.

path.description: Absolute path to the video or audio file: MP4, MOV, WebM, MP3, WAV, M4A or another format the studio opens.

position.description: Where the captions sit in the frame.

resolution.description: Short side of the video. 1440p and 4k come with Pro.

size.description: Caption size as a percent of the style's own: 125 for bigger, 80 for smaller.

style.description: Caption style. list_styles shows how each one looks.

words.description: Words per caption; 1 shows one word at a time.

name: caption_video
